messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime-regression-detector -> p99(/v1/generate_stream) in eu-west-1 crossed 3.0s threshold (observed 3.6s). Paging #oncall-sre.
Ravi Singh: ack. grabbing dashboards and active traces. link: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west1/streams?panel=latency_p99
Clara Zhou: I saw an automated canary roll 11:15 UTC for kernel-optimizer=quant-avx2 on runtime nodes. Could be related.
Evan Morales: I'm seeing a surge in ingress queue length on the nginx-ingress pods: queue_depth avg went from 2 -> 24 around 11:18. Also connection CLOSE_WAIT count increased on runtime-7.
Lexi Tran: Customer-facing impact? Support metrics show spike in streaming client reconnects and ~1% increase in short-lived sessions. No error-rate spike (5xx) yet, mostly timeouts.
Ravi Singh: quick datadog snippets: `avg(last_5m):p99(http.request.duration){route:/v1/generate_stream,region:eu-west-1}` = 3.6s. `sum(last_1m):nginx.queue_depth{env:prod,region:eu-west-1}` = 24. Traces indicate long tail at runtime token loop (tokenize->kernel exec) not network.
Clara Zhou: canary kernel-optimizer changed batched kernel selection behavior for long-sequence generation. It increased single-request CPU time for >1024 tokens. That would explain p99 but not p95.
Evan Morales: infra check: host CPU saturation on runtime hosts 7 and 9 (cpu %user 95%), io wait low. Autoscaler didn't kick because HPA based on request_rate; this is long-running requests, not more requests.
Lexi Tran: immediate action candidates: 1) disable canary kernel feature, 2) increase runtime replicas, 3) reroute heavy customers to eu-central, 4) enable fallback model (smaller context / shorter max_tokens) for streaming.
Ravi Singh: I'm going to disable the canary flag and drain canary pods. If that doesn't drop p99 in 2 min, we'll scale +3 replicas and start 10% reroute.
Clara Zhou: disabling flag now: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/flags/kernel-opt/disable -d '{"env":"eu-west-1","canary":true}'`
deploy-bot: feature flag kernel-optimizer=quant-avx2 disabled for canary in eu-west-1 (action id: f-20260315-1145). Draining 2 canary pods.
Evan Morales: scaled runtime deployment from 5 -> 8 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/runtime-prod -n prod-eu-west1 --replicas=8`. Watch CPU and queue.
Ravi Singh: after drain & scale: p95 from 1.1s -> 380ms, p99 from 3.6s -> 480ms within 90s. queue_depth back to 3. connection CLOSE_WAIT decreased.
Lexi Tran: starting gradual 10% reroute to eu-central as a precaution: `routingctl set-policy latency-fallback eu-central 10%` — notifying traffic team.
Clara Zhou: root cause hypothesis: canary kernel change caused per-request execution time increase for long sequences, which increased concurrency and caused ingress queues and CPU saturation on long-worker hosts. Autoscaler thresholds didn't catch it because HPA uses QPS.
Evan Morales: infra note: HPA owner to consider CPU-based HPA or custom metric (active long requests). I'll open a ticket.
Ravi Singh: customer impact summary: ~0.9% of streaming sessions in eu-west-1 experienced elevated tail latency for ~28 minutes; SLO p99 breached for ~22 minutes. No data corruption, no 5xx surge.
Lexi Tran: drafting support blurb: short explanation, mitigation status, recommended workaround (retry/backoff). Will sync with legal for customers on SLAs.
Clara Zhou: follow-ups: 1) confirm rollback gating for kernel optimizer (clara), 2) add HPA trigger on long_request_count (evan), 3) create synthetic long-sequence canary test in CI (ravi).
Ravi Singh: creating post-incident ticket and assigning owners. Tentative postmortem owner: @ravi. Will include timeline, canary gating failure, and rollout checklist.
deploy-bot: rollout action: kernel-optimizer=quant-avx2 removed from canary (complete).
Lexi Tran: monitoring window 30m. If stable, mark mitigated and notify stakeholders. Support message queued.
Evan Morales: note for infra: some runtime hosts unevenly scheduled; investigate scheduler affinity + pod packing. Could help avoid hotspots.
Ravi Singh: marking incident mitigated at 11:49 UTC given metrics returned to baseline. Will publish postmortem within 24h. Thanks for quick responses. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged and mitigated. Severity: SEV3. Duration: 00:34:01. Postmortem owner: Ravi Singh.
